summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Bua Luang Thai Spa landing page. All 9 backend pytest cases pass; all critical UI flows (hero, nav, multilingual switching SR/EN/RU/ZH, pricing 8 rows with RSD, contact info/map, form submit with sonner toast, HTML5 invalid-email block) work as specified.

minor.issue: SMTP login to Gmail fails with 535 BadCredentials from sandbox network (app password rejected). Per request this is acceptable: API still persists record and returns email_sent=false with email_error populated. Validated.

action_items: (Optional) Real Gmail SMTP credentials/app password may need to be re-verified — current creds return 535 BadCredentials when sending. Confirmation emails will not actually be delivered until creds work, though API correctly degrades.
(Optional) Consider sending a copy of the message to the spa inbox in addition to the submitter confirmation (currently only the submitter is emailed).
critical_code_review_comments: Logger is defined AFTER it is first referenced in send_confirmation_email (logger.exception). At import time logger isn't yet bound when the function is defined, but at runtime it resolves via module globals so it works — however, logging.basicConfig() and logger=getLogger(...) should be moved to the top of the file for clarity and to avoid future bugs.

POST /api/contact will block on smtplib timeout (up to 20s) before responding. For better UX consider fire-and-forget via BackgroundTasks so the user gets the success toast immediately even if SMTP is slow.
Pydantic v2: response_model=ContactMessage on POST is fine but EmailStr requires email-validator (already in requirements implicitly via pydantic[email]) — confirmed working.
GET /api/contact returns up to 500 records with no pagination — acceptable for MVP, flag for scale.
Frontend stores SMTP_PASSWORD in repo .env — ensure this file is gitignored before any push.
seed_data_creation: Test contact submissions inserted with TEST_ prefix (TEST_Sr User, TEST_EN, TEST_RU, TEST_ZH, TEST_ListCheck, TEST_Toast, TEST_FE User). Approximately 7-8 records added to contact_messages collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend POST /api/contact persists correctly. SMTP fails with 535 BadCredentials from sandbox; treat email_sent=false as expected. Frontend uses sonner toasts (selector li[data-sonner-toast]) and HTML5 email validation. All data-testids match the spec.
rca_of_smtp_issue: Gmail rejects login with current app password 'exvz fwql aaxq wtfj' for bualuangthailandspa@gmail.com. Could be: app password regenerated/revoked, 2FA settings, or Less Secure Apps disabled. Backend correctly catches the SMTPAuthenticationError and stores email_sent=false plus email_error, so the API itself is healthy.
